info.title: INNOVIA Fashion OS API
info.description: Connected tenant retail, inventory, returns, delivery, customer accounts, loyalty, CMS, consented inbox campaigns, staff, private photo try-on jobs and subscription invoices. Browser writes require session CSRF; native customer requests use scoped bearer tokens. Optional Fal and Stripe adapters require explicit operator configuration. SaaS billing supports individual invoices and consented monthly renewal; retail card collection requires a separate eligible merchant gateway. Extended request fields are documented in API.md and source validation schemas.
